verdict.rationale: Resend has a dedicated idempotency-keys doc stating that an idempotency key on any email request ensures the request is processed only once, even if sent multiple times. That directly covers safe retries after a network timeout. The evidence is a single one-line claim with no further detail. Missing for 10: documented key retention window and conflict/error semantics, explicit confirmation of batch-endpoint support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of duplicate suppression.
